purpose: Pin and install external agent-visibility and security tooling without copying executable source into AURELIA capital or execution planes.
runtime_policy: External tools must run outside the capital plane and cannot mutate LIVE_LOCK, Risk Warden, Execution Firewall, broker state, secrets, or execution authorization.

sources.name: visual-eyes
sources.install: source checkout; install Playwright only in isolated CI/engineering environment

sources.name: Touchpoint
sources.install: python -m pip install --no-deps -e . inside an isolated engineering virtualenv; platform dependencies remain opt-in

prohibitions: No external source is a strategy qualification.
No external source can authorize a trade.
No external source can submit a broker transaction.
No external source can read or log production secrets.
No external source can change LIVE_LOCK or FINAL_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION.
No external source is a production dependency unless separately reviewed and promoted by AURELIA governance.
